title: Sealed subject probe lock
description: The subjects.lock.json sealed during the probe phase: exactly which binary each subject resolved to and what it claimed about itself, captured before any subject runs. Written by crates/benchctl (probe.rs, seal.rs) from `<adapter> describe --json` and `<adapter> validate --experiment`. Documentation mirror of the SubjectsLock serde type in crates/bench-schema/src/lock.rs, which is the source of truth.

subjects.description: One entry per subject, in declaration order.

command.description: Exact adapter argv prefix used for this subject. Excluded from the experiment identity but pinned here as evidence.

binary_sha256.description: sha256 of the program file, when it could be read. Omitted - not null - for a subject invoked through a wrapper, a shell builtin, or anything else that is not a readable file, which is recorded honestly rather than filled in with a placeholder.

argument_binary_sha256s.description: sha256 of each further readable file named in the argument vector, keyed by the argument as written. A shim subject's real measured binary arrives as an argument rather than as the program, so hashing only the program would pin the wrapper and leave the thing under test unrecorded. Omitted when the argument vector names no readable file.

describe.description: Embedded kafkars.adapter.v1 document as printed by this binary.

validate.description: Embedded kafkars.adapter-validate.v1 report for this attempt's resolved experiment.
